identity_check: Confirmed as Intellithink (intellithink.in), the Bengaluru industrial-IoT company selling machine-health monitoring (condition-based monitoring, production monitoring, energy analytics) with its own sensors and cloud platform, products IntelliVIBE and IntelliAMP. The company site (client-rendered; its About page content was read from the site's own JS bundle), NewsKart and Ascendants (16 Apr 2026) and Venture Intelligence (17 Apr 2026) all describe the same Bengaluru machine-health business and the same leadership (Sridhar Venugopal, founder and CEO; Aswin Venu, co-founder); intellithink.com does not serve a site. Category set to adjacent (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; candidate from a NewsKart lead): it overlaps Utopian Autonomy's maintenance function — 24x7 monitoring of rotating equipment, anomaly detection and suggested fixes for steel, cement, power, oil and gas, pharma and auto plants in India — but it is a sensor-plus-dashboard condition-monitoring product (like Tractian, which §7 lists as adjacent), not an AI agent working with plant staff over WhatsApp, and no page mentions procurement, RFQ / BOM, engineering drawings or process stability.

company.name: Intellithink
company.description: Bengaluru industrial-IoT company that monitors the health of rotating plant machinery with its own sensors and a cloud analytics platform.

layer_detail: Condition-based monitoring / predictive maintenance: proprietary sensors (IntelliVIBE; IntelliAMP is a second product, not described on pages read) stream to a cloud platform that watches rotating equipment around the clock, flags anomalies and suggests fixes; also production monitoring and energy analytics. Industries listed on the site: cement, oil and gas, power generation, steel, pharmaceutical, automotive. Users are maintenance and reliability teams; dashboard product, no WhatsApp or agent interface seen.
product_summary: Industrial IoT machine-health platform: in-house sensors (IntelliVIBE, IntelliAMP) feed a cloud analytics layer that monitors rotating equipment 24x7, detects anomalies, diagnoses likely faults and suggests corrective action, alongside production-monitoring and energy-analytics modules for heavy-industry plants.
